correctness.rationale: Conditional max part distribution for uniform ordered compositions n has counts A_n(r,m)=B_n(r,m)−B_n(r,m−1), B_n(r,m)=[z^{n−r}](1+…+z^{m−1})^r; dividing each row by C(n−1,r−1)>0 does not affect determinant signs. For n≤9 independently reconstructed every row by cut-subset enumeration and exhaustively checked all C(n,k)^2 minors for 1≤k≤3, 15,111 exact minors in total, none negative. For n≥10 the three rows r=2,3,4 and decreasing maximum labels floor(n/2)+2,+1,+0 have count matrices shown in proof by unique-max configurations plus extra two-max odd case; direct determinant expansion gives −6(q²−5q+2)<0 at n=2q and −12(q−4)(q−1)<0 at n=2q+1, q≥5. Symbolic family proof covers ALL n≥10, supplementary exact calculations n=10..79 only test arithmetic.
